thresholds.Name: RotationMarginPoints
thresholds.Meaning: gate 1: adaptive beats the best single fixed rotation (one sequence for a whole band) by at least this many quality points

thresholds.Name: StyleMinimumWinShare
thresholds.Meaning: gate 2: each style is the better choice on at least this share of recipes

thresholds.Name: StyleMaximumMeanDifferencePoints
thresholds.Meaning: gate 2: neither style beats the other by more on average

thresholds.Name: StyleTieMarginPoints
thresholds.Meaning: gate 2: a recipe within this many points is a tie, half a win each

thresholds.Name: PerksOptionalRank
thresholds.Meaning: gate 3: rank of the unperked crafter

thresholds.Name: PerksOptionalMinimumFullQualityShare
thresholds.Meaning: gate 3: share of crafts that reach maximum quality, per at-level band

thresholds.Name: PerksOptionalBands
thresholds.Meaning: gate 3: the at-level recipe bands

thresholds.Name: MaterialTolerance
thresholds.Meaning: gate 5: component stacks per item within this share of the legacy baseline (above it only, where the legacy success rate is below the next value)

thresholds.Name: MaterialTwoSidedMinimumLegacySuccess
thresholds.Meaning: gate 5: cells where the legacy policy succeeds at least this often keep the two-sided parity; below it, using less material passes

thresholds.Name: MaterialExtraNeverCraftedShare
thresholds.Meaning: gate 5: recipes never made may exceed the legacy share by at most this

thresholds.Name: MaterialQualityShortfallPoints
thresholds.Meaning: gate 5: the new average quality may be at most this many points below the legacy player's

thresholds.Name: XpRateMinimumRatio
thresholds.Meaning: gate 6: XP per hour divided by the legacy rate

thresholds.Name: LegacySecondsPerAction
thresholds.Meaning: gate 6: seconds per action in the old craft window (unmeasured estimate)

thresholds.Name: OverheadSecondsPerAttempt
thresholds.Meaning: gate 6: seconds per craft besides actions, both loops (unmeasured estimate)

thresholds.Name: EnhancementParityRank
thresholds.Meaning: gate 7: rank of the enhancing crafter (best gear)

thresholds.Name: EnhancementParityBands
thresholds.Meaning: gate 7: the at-level recipe bands

thresholds.Name: EnhancementSlotCounts
thresholds.Meaning: gates 6 and 7: numbers of filled enhancement slots played

thresholds.Name: EnhancementParityMinimumRatio
thresholds.Meaning: gate 7: expected transferred enhancements per enhanced craft divided by today's

thresholds.Name: RecipesPerBand
thresholds.Meaning: recipes played per band

thresholds.Name: SolverOptions
thresholds.Meaning: effort of the fixed-rotation solver

thresholds.Name: ActionLimit
thresholds.Meaning: actions after which an attempt counts as stalled
